text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The distance is 2200m. Close to the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks) where Nishino Flower struggled. It seems bitter memories still linger strongly with her—"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...You believed that I "could do it!",
didn't you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then... I'm scared,
but I'll be fine.
